content:
Taylor: Quick thread to finalize the lightning webinar runbook. Goal: 35m content, 20m Q&A, three 90s micro-demos with a single fallback video per demo. Need final speaker assets by Wed noon.
Jo: Asset checklist? Trying to keep it minimal so speakers actually send stuff.
Taylor: Minimal required per speaker: 1) 2-slide storyboard PDF (demo steps + takeaway/CTA), 2) prompts.txt (happy/edge/fallback), 3) expected_output.txt (one sample per prompt, ~1-2 lines), 4) fallback-demo.mp4 (90s), 5) latency_notes.txt (p50/p95), 6) short bio + headshot.
Kofi: For prompts.txt please use plain lines with a one-line success note after each prompt. Example: 
```
happy: "Summarize this usage report for PMs in 3 bullets"
success: "3 accurate bullets, no hallucinated features"
edge: "Report is 6k chars - extract top-3 impacts"
fallback: "If p95 > 600ms switch to compact-v2"
```
Marta: Rehearsal cadence suggestion: week-before microlabs (20m per speaker), two full dress runs (panel + tech) the day before. OpsBot, can you create events when speakers post windows?
OpsBot: Yes. Post preferred 90-minute windows here and I will create Zoom + calendar invites with label #webinar-rehearsal and attach the asset checklist. I will also create a tiny poll template for the intro.
Jo: Lead routing: attendees who click demo link -> SDR queue A, attendees who ask technical Qs -> infra SDR queue, others to nurture. Use UTMs to drive routing.
Taylor: Tracking metrics: registrant->attendee % (target 50%), live-demo-success % (target 95), fallback occurrences, MQL rate from engaged attendees (target 35-45%). Also capture token usage and model variant per demo.
Kofi: Failover runbook: if demo latency causes >10s wait or p95 > 700ms, OpsBot will swap to fallback-demo.mp4 and mark fallback_used in tracker. Speakers, please include a one-line handoff intro before the recorded clip.
Marta: Who moderates Q&A? I can run the first segment and route deep technical prompts to infra SME. Jo, can you handle audience polling?
Jo: Yep. I'll prepare two polls: role + biggest constraint (cost/latency/ops). Also a mid-session CTA poll (interested in pilot?).
Taylor: Final timeline: drop assets by Wed noon, post rehearsal windows by Wed EOD, microlabs Thu, full dress Fri AM. OpsBot will confirm invites Monday. Thanks all 680
